description: In crates/core/src/group_log/backfill.rs, if want_id is already locally present the function returns Ok(0) immediately without checking whether want_id is already in the group tip set. If the tip set is stale (e.g. after the crash scenario in append), the entry is present but not a tip, and backfill silently reports success without advancing tips. Callers that rely on backfill to make want_id reachable via list_tips will be silently wrong. Fix: after detecting the entry is present, check whether it is already a tip and if not call advance_tips (or at minimum document the limitation clearly).
title: backfill: already-present want_id returns Ok(0) without checking tip staleness
